title.zh-TW: 系統提示詞支援即時重算，調校文案免重啟對話
title.en: Real-Time System Prompt Re-Rendering Without Restarting Conversations

body.zh-TW: 正在反覆微調提示詞（prompt）卻苦於每次改動都得開新對話，新的 `--system-prompt-snapshot off` 旗標正是為此而生。當你在打磨自訂提示詞內容時，系統預設會沿用工作階段初次錄製的提示詞快照，導致你在外側修改了檔案文字，當前的對話依然讀取舊版內容。現在只要在啟動 Claude 時帶上這個選項，每一次發出提問都會重新讀取並渲染最新的系統提示詞，讓文案調校的測試過程變得更加靈活迅速。⟦整套流程好似在排練室試穿戲服，每次出場都當場換上最新修改的布料剪裁，不必每修一針就得解散劇組重新開演。⟧
body.en: If you are iterating on prompt text and tired of starting a new conversation for every tweak, the new `--system-prompt-snapshot off` flag is built for you. When polishing custom prompt content, the system by default reuses the prompt snapshot recorded at session start, causing active conversations to keep reading stale content even after you edit external files. Now, by passing this flag when launching Claude, every request will reload and render the latest system prompt fresh, making prompt experimentation much faster and more flexible. ⟦The entire workflow is like trying on costumes in a rehearsal hall: actors step onto the stage wearing the latest fabric adjustments on the spot, rather than dismissing the entire cast to restart the show after every stitch.⟧

title.zh-TW: 外部工具異動保全推論思考，切換模型快取不漏接
title.en: Reasoning Preserved Across Tool Changes, Cache Reuse Holds on Model Switches

body.zh-TW: 當你請 Claude 呼叫外部工具或中途切換模型時，先前辛苦推導的思考脈絡不再無端消失。⟦這好比多位專家在會議室白板上記錄解題推導，中途就算外聘顧問進出或更換麥克風，也不會突然把整面黑板的心算擦掉重抄。⟧以往 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器重送模型已載入的工具、內建工具重繪，或工具因斷線升級而消失時，清單重寫往往會丟失先前的思考內容；如今推論皆能妥善保留。在未開啟工具搜尋的工作階段中，外掛動態加入也會改以延遲定義傳遞，避免破壞快取（把算過結果暫存起來直接用）複用。透過 `/model` 切換模型時不再重發全部工具定義；commit 與 PR 的歸屬文字改以對話附註送達，並會在切換模型時更新，且 claude.ai 連接器工具在工作階段更動時也能保住推論記憶。
body.en: When Claude invokes external tools or switches models mid-session, previously accumulated reasoning context no longer vanishes unexpectedly. ⟦This is like experts solving equations across a conference room whiteboard: even if guest consultants walk in and out or microphones get swapped, no one suddenly wipes the entire board clean to start over.⟧ Previously, when an MCP server re-sent definitions, a built-in tool re-rendered, or a tool disappeared due to disconnections or upgrades, rewriting the tool list discarded earlier thinking; reasoning is now safely preserved. In sessions without ToolSearch, dynamically added plugin tools are now passed as deferred definitions to prevent breaking prompt-cache reuse. Switching models via `/model` no longer re-sends every tool definition; commit and PR attribution text now arrives as a conversation note that updates on model changes, and reasoning memory is also retained when claude.ai connector tools change across session resumes.

title.zh-TW: 恢復工作階段沿用工具描述，背景任務不破壞提示快取
title.en: Resumed Sessions Reuse Tool Descriptions, Background Tasks Preserve Prompt Cache

body.zh-TW: 重新打開先前未完成的工作階段時，最怕背景暫存全部失效導致推論延遲。以前從對話分岔出的背景工作單元若把 `EnterWorktree` 這個工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）工具加進對話的工具清單，便會破壞快取重用機制。現在恢復工作階段時，不會再因 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）重連時間差而改寫工具清單或丟失思考，首回合執行工具時也能直接重播既有描述而非重新渲染。此外，從 `-p` 印出模式切換至互動模式時系統提示詞前綴保持一致。透過 `--system-prompt` 或 `--append-system-prompt` 啟動的子代理與工作階段，也會一次記錄提示詞與工具定義，不再每次重新渲染。⟦延續同一個會議記錄思維，這就像隔天回到會議室復工時，直接對照昨天蓋印封存的會議底稿接續討論，不會因為助手分頭跑腿或翻開備份記錄就擅自撕掉前言。⟧
body.en: When reopening unfinished sessions, cache invalidation causing inference delays is a major pain point. Previously, when a background worker forked from a conversation added `EnterWorktree` to the conversation's tool block, it broke prompt-cache reuse. Now when resuming a session, tool lists are no longer rewritten and thinking is no longer dropped due to MCP reconnection timing differences; turns executing tools on the first step also replay recorded descriptions directly instead of re-rendering them. Additionally, the system prompt prefix remains consistent when resuming a print-mode (`-p`) conversation interactively. Subagents and sessions launched with `--system-prompt` or `--append-system-prompt` now record prompt and tool definitions once instead of re-rendering them. ⟦Continuing the meeting records analogy, this is like resuming work in the conference room the next day with yesterday's stamped and sealed minutes, without tearing off the preface just because assistants ran errands or opened backup logs.⟧

title.zh-TW: 工件發布支援斷線自動重試，明確指出損壞字元行數與欄位
title.en: Artifact Publishing Adds Auto-Retry on Disconnects, Pinpoints Corrupted Character Locations

body.zh-TW: 發布工件（artifact，在獨立視窗展示的成果文件）若中途網路斷線或遇到格式錯誤，現在不再只回傳不明原因的失敗代碼。在過去，如果上傳檔案時連線中斷，Claude Code 往往只能回報未知結果；如今只要判定傳輸未完成，就會自動重試 1 次以確保順利送達。當頁面檔案並非有效的 UTF-8 編碼，或是包含代表損毀的替換字元（U+FFFD）時，錯誤訊息也不再模糊帶過，而是會具體標示出需要修正的行數與欄位。若工件發布遭到拒絕，畫面亦會清楚解釋被拒原因以及具體的應對處置方法。⟦這套防護有如印刷廠送件作業，遇到斷線能自動重發一次，內容包含損壞字元時會明確指出第幾行第幾列，被拒絕出版時也會清楚說明退件原因與修改方針。⟧
body.en: When publishing artifacts, network drops or formatting errors no longer return vague failure codes. Previously, if a connection was cut off mid-upload, Claude Code often reported an unknown outcome; now, whenever it detects that an upload never completed, it automatically retries once to ensure delivery. When a page file is not valid UTF-8 or contains replacement characters (U+FFFD) indicating corruption, error messages no longer gloss over the issue, instead explicitly naming the line and column to fix. If an artifact publish is refused, the screen also clearly explains the reason along with actionable remediation steps. ⟦This protection is like submitting print jobs to a press: it automatically retries once if transmission drops, pinpoints exact row and column numbers if corrupted characters appear, and provides clear rejection reasons and revision instructions if publishing is turned down.⟧

Fixed artifact publish failing with an unhelpful error when the page file isn't valid UTF-8 or contains a replacement character (U+FFFD); the error now names the line and column to fix
Improved Artifact tool publish errors: when a publish is refused, the message now says why and what to do about it

title.zh-TW: 遠端操控憑證過期自動續期，及時同步桌面與編輯器權限
title.en: Automatic Renewal for Expired Remote Control Credentials, Real-Time Desktop and Editor Permission Sync

body.zh-TW: 在遠端電腦透過 `claude remote-control` 連線工作時，長時間掛機最怕憑證失效讓所有連線瞬間中斷。⟦這如同在長效監控哨所配置專用通信機，遇到月度密碼過期會自行向總部換約重連而不斷線，新加入的聯絡終端也能即時掌握目前的防衛等級。⟧以往遠端伺服器憑證在大約 30 天過期後，主機行程會直接退出並切斷所有掛載的工作階段；現在主機端會自動重新註冊憑證並持續保持運作。同時，新加入 Claude Desktop 或 VS Code 工作階段的遠端操控客戶端，之前常停留在過期的舊權限模式直到手動變更，如今一連上就能立刻呈現即時且正確的權限狀態。
body.en: When working on a remote machine via `claude remote-control`, long-running sessions no longer suffer sudden drops from expired credentials. ⟦This is like equipping an outpost with a dedicated communicator that automatically renews its monthly passcode with headquarters without dropping the link, while newly connected terminals instantly reflect current defense levels.⟧ Previously, when server credentials expired after about 30 days, the host process exited and dropped all attached sessions; now the host automatically re-registers and keeps running. Meanwhile, Remote Control clients joining a Claude Desktop or VS Code session previously remained on stale permission modes until changed manually, but now immediately reflect accurate, up-to-date permission states upon connecting.

title.zh-TW: 企業受管設定嚴密把關，雲端憑證逾期精確回報
title.en: Strict Enterprise Managed Settings Enforcement, Accurate Cloud Credential Expiration Reporting

body.zh-TW: 在由公司統一控管規則的企業環境中，雲端排程與登入驗證具備更嚴密的防護。受管設定要求沙箱時 Cowork 雲端排程啟動失敗已修復；`allowedHttpHookUrls`、`httpHookAllowedEnvVars` 與 `allowedChannelPlugins` 讀取失敗時一律不予放行。在 Claude Desktop 下 AWS 或 Google Cloud 憑證過期不再盲目重試 10 次，改為提示重新認證；強制閘道登入框按 Esc 即可關閉。自建執行端會回報 `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` 並對使用舊代理的工作階段提出警示，轉發身分遇 429 限制不再轉移上游以落實每人配額。⟦整體防護宛若金融大樓的安全閘道，條文讀取不清時一律從嚴封鎖，身分過期不再盲目空轉十次，限制也確實落實到每位個別訪客頭上。⟧
body.en: In enterprise environments governed by centralized policies, cloud scheduling and login authentication now receive tighter safeguards. Startup failures for Cowork cloud scheduled tasks in organizations requiring sandboxing are now fixed; unreadable `allowedHttpHookUrls`, `httpHookAllowedEnvVars`, and `allowedChannelPlugins` settings now admit nothing rather than everything. Under Claude Desktop, expired AWS or Google Cloud credentials no longer blindly retry 10 times, prompting for re-authentication instead; pressing Esc now closes the mandatory gateway login dialog. Self-hosted runners now report `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` and warn sessions cloning via the legacy proxy, while `forward_user_identity` passes 429 rate limits directly to developers rather than failing over upstreams to enforce per-user quotas. ⟦The overall defense resembles security turnstiles in a financial building: unreadable rules strictly deny entry, expired badges no longer trigger ten pointless retry spins, and limits are enforced on every individual visitor.⟧

title.zh-TW: 終端機按鍵與滾動修復，輸入文字不再延遲跳格
title.en: Terminal Keystroke and Scrolling Fixes, Jitter-Free Responsive Text Input

body.zh-TW: 在手機或終端機全螢幕下操作各項指令，文字輸入與介面捲動現在更加乾淨俐落。⟦這恰似把老舊放映機的齒輪重新校準，打字輸入不再因為背景動畫轉動而延遲跳格，切換視窗或滑動閱覽時畫面資訊也穩定呈現。⟧以前在代理人檢視中重新連線至 tmux 或 ssh 工作階段後，Shift+Enter 換行與 Option+Backspace 刪除單詞等快捷鍵會失效，如今已完全修復。行動端設備執行 `/context` 等本機指令時輸出空白的問題已獲解決，在全螢幕向上滾動時，對話頂端也能正常顯示淡色的上一則提問提示。此外，`/diff` 程式碼差異面板不再先閃爍零個檔案變更與載入轉圈才定格，無改動時的空白提示也已置中對齊，打字時按鍵更不會被載入動畫卡住延遲。
body.en: Operating commands across mobile clients or fullscreen terminals is now much smoother for text input and interface scrolling. ⟦This is like recalibrating the gears of a classic projector: typing input no longer lags behind background animations, and screen details remain steady when switching windows or scrolling.⟧ Previously inside agent views, reconnecting to tmux or ssh sessions broke shortcuts like Shift+Enter for newlines and Option+Backspace for word deletion; these are now fully fixed. Blank outputs when running local commands like `/context` on mobile devices have been resolved, and scrolling up in fullscreen mode now reliably shows the dim last-prompt header at the top. Additionally, the `/diff` code difference panel no longer flashes "0 files changed" with a spinner before settling, its empty state is centered, and keystrokes are no longer delayed by loading animations.

title.zh-TW: 恢復大容量歷史對話不掉內容，用量警示燈號穩定顯示
title.en: Restoring Large Conversation Transcripts Without Data Loss, Stable Usage Warnings

body.zh-TW: 恢復先前對話或載入超過 5 MB 的超大歷史紀錄時，整個還原過程變得更乾淨迅速。以前在包含大量 Bash 工具呼叫的對話中執行 `--resume`，首次渲染畫面常需等待；現在首次渲染更快。當工作階段的對話紀錄超過 5 MB 時，先前重新載入對話容易漏失平行工具呼叫與掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）輸出，如今資料都能完整重現。透過 `-p --resume` 執行 `/compact` 壓縮或其他斜線指令後，對話中也不會再多生出一筆多餘的接續提示。如果工作階段中因切換不同模型或模式而回傳不同的額度週期，用量上限警示也不會再忽明忽暗地閃爍。⟦整個載入流程好比翻開厚重的歷史卷宗，即使檔案超過 5 MB 且包含多條平行批註也能完整讀取，恢復作業時不再無故多插一張空白備忘頁。⟧
body.en: Resuming previous conversations and loading massive transcripts over 5 MB is now cleaner and faster. Previously, running `--resume` on sessions with many Bash tool calls caused noticeable delays on first render; first-render time is now shorter. When a session transcript exceeds 5 MB, reloading used to drop parallel tool calls and their hook output; all of it now comes back intact. If switching models or modes within a session returns varying quota windows, usage-limit warnings no longer flicker on and off. ⟦The entire loading process is like opening a heavy historical archive: even files exceeding 5 MB with parallel marginal notes load completely, without inserting an unneeded blank memo page upon resumption.⟧

title.zh-TW: 終端指令回傳白話說明，市集路徑防護與沙箱複製指引
title.en: Plain-Language Terminal Command Descriptions, Marketplace Path Containment and Sandbox Copy Guidance

body.zh-TW: 讓 Claude 在自動模式或沙箱環境執行工作時，工具的引導說明與安全把關變得更親切嚴謹。以往執行終端命令時，Claude 常只是機械式複誦指令；現在更新了 Bash 工具說明指引，引導它用大白話解釋命令的作用。在沙箱內若遇到 `pbcopy` 等剪貼簿指令執行失敗，Claude 會主動建議改用內建的 `/copy` 指令。工作流程中帶有龐大輸出結構的 `agent()` 呼叫，在自動模式下不再直接被拒，而是交由安全分類器審查。在 macOS 與 Linux 上，外掛市集路徑帶有反斜線可繞過邊界檢查的漏洞已堵死；`claude agents` 的 `@` 選單也能即時列出工作階段開啟後新建立的儲存庫。⟦這如同給領航員換上更清晰的作業指南，執行指令時會用白話解釋步驟，遇到封閉環境複製失敗時也會主動推薦替代指令。⟧
body.en: When running Claude in auto mode or sandboxed environments, tool descriptions and security checks are now clearer and stricter. Previously when executing terminal commands, Claude often mechanically echoed the command; updated Bash tool guidance now steers it to explain what commands do in plain words. Inside the sandbox, if clipboard commands like `pbcopy` fail, Claude proactively suggests using the built-in `/copy` command. In workflows, `agent()` calls with large output schemas are no longer flatly refused in auto mode, routing to the safety classifier for review instead. On macOS and Linux, a case where a marketplace entry path containing a backslash could bypass the containment check has been closed, and the `claude agents` `@` menu now lists repositories created after session start. ⟦This is like giving a navigator clearer operational guidelines: explaining steps in plain terms when issuing commands, and recommending alternative commands when copy operations fail inside closed quarters.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Workflow `agent()` calls with large output schemas being refused in auto mode instead of being checked by the safety classifier
Fixed a case where a marketplace entry path containing a backslash could bypass the containment check for fetched marketplaces on macOS and Linux
Fixed `claude agents` `@` directory menu not listing repositories created after the session started
Improved the Bash tool's description guidance so Claude describes what a command does in plain words instead of echoing the command
Improved sandbox guidance so Claude suggests `/copy` when clipboard commands such as `pbcopy` fail inside the sandbox

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 差異檢視跟隨編輯器主題，修復截圖貼上與多語系文字
title.en: [VSCode] Diff View Adapts to Editor Themes, Fixes for Screenshot Pasting and Multilingual Text

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡與 Claude 對話，程式碼差異對照面板現在能完美貼合你的編輯器主題。⟦體驗改善有如為繪圖板換上具備自動調色的多功能畫布，不管是貼上圖片、選用高對比深淺外觀，或是處理帶有空格的檔名，筆觸都精準無誤。⟧過去對話框中的變更區塊總是強制以深色佈景顯示，現在會同步套用當前啟用的色彩主題與高對比模式。在 WSL2 或 WSLg 環境下貼上螢幕截圖時，不再把原始圖片位元組塞進輸入框，而是直接轉成附件或自動略過；同時修復了混合由右至左語系與英文時文字順序錯亂的問題。在檔案修改方面，採 Windows（CRLF）換行格式的檔案在確認套用變更時不再噴出找不到字串的錯誤，且使用 `@` 提及檔案時也不會漏掉路徑帶有空格的檔案。
body.en: When chatting with Claude in VS Code, code diff panels now align with your active editor theme. ⟦The upgrade is like outfitting a graphics tablet with an auto-adjusting color canvas: whether pasting images, choosing high-contrast dark or light themes, or handling filenames with spaces, every stroke remains precise.⟧ Previously, chat diff blocks always rendered with a dark theme; they now follow the active VS Code color theme, including high contrast. Pasting screenshots on WSL2 or WSLg no longer inserts raw bytes into the chat input, instead attaching the image or ignoring the paste if unavailable; typing mixed right-to-left and English text in the wrong order has also been fixed. For file edits, accepting changes in diff view on files with Windows (CRLF) line endings no longer fails with "String not found in file", and `@`-mentions no longer drop files with spaces in their paths.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed pasting a screenshot on WSL2/WSLg inserting raw image bytes into the chat input; the image is now attached when the clipboard provides it, otherwise the paste is ignored
[VSCode] Fixed chat diff blocks always rendering with a dark editor theme; they now follow the active VS Code color theme, including high contrast
[VSCode] Fixed mixed right-to-left and English text rendering in the wrong order while typing in the message input
[VSCode] Fixed accepting an edit in the diff view on a file with Windows (CRLF) line endings failing with "String not found in file"
[VSCode] Fixed @-mentions dropping files whose paths contain spaces

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 遠端工作階段清單載入修復，排除循環歷史與行程空轉
title.en: [VSCode] Remote Session List Loading Fixes, Eliminating Cyclic Loops and Runaway Processes

body.zh-TW: 開啟含有大量捷徑或龐大專案的遠端主機時，VS Code 擴充套件不再因循環紀錄或檔案搜尋而把 CPU 衝上 100%。過去當對話存檔中包含循環的父層關聯時，進行對話分支、編輯歷史訊息或執行倒轉操作會導致外掛主機直接卡死在 100% CPU，現已修復。透過 Remote-SSH 連線且工作區資料夾僅存在於遠端電腦時，工作階段清單介面過去會載入失敗，目前已能正常顯示。此外，在超大型專案或含有密集符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）的工作環境中檢視檔案時，背景搜尋工具 ripgrep 行程失控狂飆的問題也獲得了解決。⟦承接同一個工作環境的平穩運作，這好似為巡檢機具加裝轉速調節器，遇到跨主機遠端連線或大量捷徑檔案時不再失控空轉。⟧
body.en: When connecting to remote hosts with symlink-heavy or massive codebases, the VS Code extension no longer spikes CPU to 100% over cyclic transcripts or file searches. Previously, when saved transcripts contained cyclic parent links, forking, editing earlier messages, or rewinding caused the extension host to hang at 100% CPU; this is now fixed. In windows connected over Remote-SSH where the workspace folder exists only on the remote host, the sessions list view previously failed to load and now renders properly. Additionally, runaway background ripgrep processes when viewing files in large or symlink-heavy workspaces have been resolved. ⟦Continuing the smooth operation of this workspace, this is like adding a speed governor to inspection machinery, preventing uncontrolled spinning during cross-host remote connections or encounters with heavy shortcuts.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the extension host hanging at 100% CPU when forking, editing an earlier message, or rewinding in a conversation whose saved transcript contains a cyclic parent link
[VSCode] Fixed the sessions list view failing to load in windows connected over Remote-SSH when the workspace folder exists only on the remote host
[VSCode] Fixed runaway ripgrep processes when viewing files in large or symlink-heavy workspaces

title.zh-TW: [Claude Code on the web] 企業版 GitHub 授權自動換新，調度本人帳號備援呼叫
title.en: [Claude Code on the web] Automatic Token Refresh for GitHub Enterprise, Personal Account Fallback for API Calls

body.zh-TW: 透過網頁版 Claude Code 操作 GitHub 企業伺服器時，逾期的 token（授權令牌，用於身分認證）現在會自動換新。⟦這宛如在雲端工作台配置全天候秘書，遇到通行權杖逾期會自動換發，即使所屬單位未安裝官方擴充套件，也能直接採用你本人的帳號順暢銜接。⟧先前在 GitHub Enterprise Server 的工作階段中，只要個人認證憑證到期，介面就會誤標為帳號已斷線；如今在進行拉取請求（PR）或討論議題操作時，系統會自動在背景刷新授權並保持連線。另外，在尚未安裝 Claude GitHub App 的組織架構下，執行 `gh` 命令或呼叫 API 原先會直接報錯，現在會直接改用你已綁定的 GitHub 帳號發送請求，若尚未登入也會明確提示。
body.en: When working with GitHub Enterprise Server via Claude Code on the web, expired tokens now refresh automatically. ⟦This is like assigning a 24/7 assistant to your cloud workbench: when access tokens expire, they are renewed automatically, and work carries on under your personal account even if the organization lacks the official app.⟧ Previously in GitHub Enterprise Server sessions, expired authentication credentials caused the interface to report the GitHub account as disconnected; PR and issue operations now automatically refresh tokens in the background to stay connected. Additionally, in organizations without the Claude GitHub App installed, running `gh` commands or making GitHub API calls previously threw errors, but now routes through your connected GitHub account and explicitly notes when none is connected.

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed GitHub Enterprise Server sessions showing your GitHub account as disconnected once its token expired; PR and issue operations now refresh it automatically
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed `gh` and GitHub API calls failing in organizations without the Claude GitHub App; they now use your connected GitHub account and say so when none is connected

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 預設連線支援切換自訂通道，額度耗盡清楚指引儲值

body.zh-TW: 負責管理 Claude Tag 團隊連線的管理者，現在不必刪除重來就能將預設通道切換至自訂連接器。在後台設定預設連線表單時，新加入的「Use a custom connector」連結允許你中途直接轉向自訂通道。當團隊組織的用量額度耗盡時，Claude 過去只會冰冷回報 API 拒絕了無效請求，現在會具體說明額度已用完並指引儲值方法。在頻道頂層發布訊息後，成員在討論串內要求編輯或刪除該則貼文時，指令不再被誤判為對話糾錯，而是確實轉交給當初發文的工作階段處理。此外，管理審查介面的工具存取授權請求點擊「Connect」時，之前常跳出授權失敗或誤報授權包已刪除的問題也已修正。⟦整個調整就像在團隊客服總機後台增加切換自訂外線的捷徑，額度用盡時明確告知儲值途徑，留言串內的修改請求也能準確遞交給當初發文的專員。⟧
body.en: Administrators managing Claude Tag team connections can now switch preset connections to custom connectors without starting over. When configuring preset connection forms in admin settings, a newly added "Use a custom connector" link lets you pivot directly to custom channels. When an organization runs out of usage credits, Claude previously replied with a generic message stating the API rejected an invalid request; it now explicitly explains credits are exhausted and details how to add more. After Claude posts a message at a channel's top level, thread requests to edit or delete that post are no longer treated as conversational corrections, routing properly to the session that originally posted it. Additionally, clicking **Connect** on Tool access requests under Admin settings > Review requests previously failed with "Authorization failed" or showed the access bundle as deleted; this has now been resolved. ⟦The overall update is like adding a shortcut to switch to custom outside lines in a team switchboard: clearly guiding top-ups when credit runs out and routing thread edit requests to the original dispatcher.⟧

items.original:

[Claude Tag] Fixed thread requests to edit or delete a message Claude posted at the channel's top level being answered with a correction instead of reaching the session that posted it
[Claude Tag] Fixed **Connect** on Tool access requests under Admin settings > Review requests failing with "Authorization failed" or showing the requested access bundle as deleted

body.en: Want to work on multiple branches simultaneously without cluttering your current directory? Codex now introduces experimental worktree support. ⟦This is like a library setting up private study rooms for major research projects, allowing researchers to work behind closed doors with copies of materials, step out to browse progress across rooms, and return later to resume unfinished work without occupying shared reading tables.⟧ Simply pass the `--worktree` flag at startup or enter the `/worktree` command in a conversation to create isolated checkout directories for new or forked sessions. title.zh-TW: Vim 編輯新增 R 取代模式，支援復原與重複操作並改善退出鍵
title.en: Vim Editing Adds R Replace Mode with Undo, Dot-Repeat, and Reliable Escape Handling

body.zh-TW: 習慣 Vim 鍵盤操作的開發者，在編輯草稿時手感將更加俐落。這次更新為 Vim 模式補上了經典的 `R` 取代模式，讓你可以直接覆蓋游標處的字元。進行文字替換時，你能按鍵復原（undo，回復到修改前的文字），也能利用小數點鍵重複執行上一次的取代動作。針對舊型終端機，更新也改善了 Escape 鍵的訊號處理，讓跳離編輯模式的操作更可靠，避免按鍵延遲或失靈。⟦此舉有如手寫打字機具備了即時覆蓋色帶，既能直接壓字修正錯別字，又能藉由倒退鍵復原上一步或連打重複印字，同時也把老舊按鍵卡榫徹底潤滑修好。⟧
body.en: Developers accustomed to Vim keybindings will enjoy a snappier draft editing experience. This update brings the classic `R` replace mode to Vim mode, allowing you to overwrite characters directly under the cursor. During text replacement, you can undo changes and use the dot key to repeat your previous replacement action. For legacy terminals, the update improves Escape key handling, making exiting edit modes more reliable and avoiding key delays or failures. ⟦This is like a typewriter equipped with an instant correction ribbon that overwrites typos, allows backspacing to undo or repeating keystrokes, while fully lubricating worn-out mechanical key joints.⟧

items.original: Vim editing gains `R` replace mode with undo and dot-repeat, plus more reliable Escape handling in legacy terminals. (#42194, #42584)

title.zh-TW: 複製回覆保留富文字格式，/copy 指令支援狀態與欄位擷取
title.en: Copying Responses Preserves Rich-Text Formatting as /copy Gains Status and Field Extraction

body.zh-TW: 將對話產生的程式碼或說明貼到其他文書軟體時，排版不再被打亂成純文字了。現在從 Codex 複製回覆內容，貼入支援富文字（rich-text，包含粗體、標題與程式碼區塊等排版樣式）的應用程式時，會完整保留原本的格式外觀。與此同時，命令列工具的 `/copy` 指令也迎來功能強化，除了複製回覆本身，現在還能單獨複製狀態輸出，或是擷取工作階段內的特定個別欄位。⟦一如專業相機輸出照片，既能直接沖洗出帶有完整色彩與層次細節的精緻相片，也可以單獨將相機當前的拍攝數據或特定參數獨立匯出備查。⟧這讓整理文件與分享除錯資訊變得更順暢。
body.en: Pasting generated code or explanations into other document apps will no longer scramble formatting into plain text. Copying responses from Codex into rich-text applications now fully preserves the original styling and appearance. Meanwhile, the command-line `/copy` command has been enhanced to copy status output or extract specific individual fields from a session in addition to the response itself. ⟦Just like a professional camera outputting photos, which can develop fine prints with full color and tonal detail, or independently export current shooting metadata and specific parameters for reference.⟧ This makes organizing documentation and sharing debugging information much smoother.

items.original: Copying responses preserves formatting in rich-text apps, and `/copy` can copy status output or individual session fields. (#42847, #43055)

title.zh-TW: 現有工作階段動態辨識外掛工具，升級回捲自動重新整理
title.en: Existing Sessions Dynamically Detect Plugin Tools and Refresh on Upgrades or Rollbacks

body.zh-TW: 當你手邊的工作階段正在進行，外部外掛有了變更也不需要關掉重開。⟦這如同工廠的工具旋轉吊架，在技師開工期間若由後勤人員掛上新零件或替換工具規格，技師不必停工重開電閘，轉身就能直接拿取最新到貨的工具與操作手冊。⟧既有的工作階段現在具備動態感知能力，能在不中斷執行的情況下，即刻辨識剛安裝好的外掛工具。當外掛在外部完成升級或執行版本回捲時，當前視窗會立即重新整理相應的技能。連同內部定義的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）也會一併更新，確保所有自動化流程即時生效。
body.en: When your current session is running, you no longer need to restart it when external plugins change. ⟦This is like a factory rotating tool rack where logistics staff hang new parts or replace tool specifications while technicians work, allowing technicians to grab newly arrived tools and manuals without shutting down power or halting work.⟧ Existing sessions now feature dynamic detection to recognize newly installed plugin tools without interrupting execution. When plugins are upgraded or rolled back externally, the active window immediately refreshes corresponding skills. Internally defined hooks are updated as well, ensuring all automated workflows take effect immediately.

items.original: Existing sessions pick up newly installed plugin tools and refresh skills and hooks after external plugin upgrades or rollbacks. (#42284, #42593, #42990)

title.zh-TW: MCP 連線協調權杖更新與登入挑戰，舊版伺服器啟動入口退場
title.en: MCP Connections Coordinate Token Refreshes and Login Challenges as Legacy Entry Point Retires

body.zh-TW: 透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）串接外部服務時，授權憑證的維護現在更安全且井然有序。當多個工具連線需要更新 OAuth 授權權杖（token，用來驗證身分的授權令牌）時，Codex 會統一協調這些連線的更新動作。若更新失敗，介面會主動跳出登入驗證挑戰提示，絕不自動重播先前已被拒絕的工具呼叫。此外，先前已被標記為棄用的 `codex mcp-server` 啟動入口也在本次更新中正式移除。⟦猶如園區更新外包廠商的門禁機制，廠商證件過期時由系統集中協調換證，換證失敗即引導人員臨櫃重新認證，絕不拿遭拒的舊卡重複硬刷閘門；同時管理處也正式封閉已張貼告示的舊側門。⟧
body.en: Maintaining authorization credentials when connecting to external services via MCP is now safer and more orderly. When multiple tool connections require OAuth token refreshes, Codex coordinates the refresh across those connections. If a refresh fails, the interface surfaces login challenges without automatically replaying previously rejected tool calls. In addition, the previously deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is officially removed in this release. ⟦This is like an office park updating contractor access control, where expired badges are renewed through centralized coordination, failed renewals direct personnel to service counters for re-verification without repeatedly swiping rejected cards at gates, and management seals off the deprecated side entrance.⟧

items.original:
MCP connections coordinate OAuth token refreshes and surface login challenges when refresh fails, without automatically replaying rejected tool calls. (#42413, #42552)
The deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is no longer available. (#42993)

title.zh-TW: 啟動流程阻擋未信任輔助程式，macOS 沙盒嚴防終端機注入
title.en: Startup Blocks Untrusted Workspace Helpers as macOS Sandbox Prevents Terminal Injection

body.zh-TW: 開啟陌生專案目錄或在蘋果電腦上執行終端機，資安防線在開工當下就已全面就位。現在 Codex 在啟動過程中，若尚未與當前工作區建立明確的信任關係，會主動避免執行任何由工作區控制的輔助程式，杜絕惡意腳本趁虛而入。與此同時，macOS 系統下的沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護層）也經過強化，能確實阻擋未經許可的終端機輸入注入攻擊。⟦這好似進入高度管制的實驗室，外部帶來的隨身器材在通過信任檢驗前一律禁止插電啟動，而隔離艙門的防護隔板也能阻擋外界未授權的按鈕信號干擾。⟧這讓你在檢視未知程式碼時能受到更周密的保護。
body.en: When opening unfamiliar project directories or running terminals on Mac computers, security defenses are active right from the start. During startup, Codex actively avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before establishing trust with the current workspace, preventing malicious scripts from taking advantage. Meanwhile, the macOS sandbox has been strengthened to block unauthorized terminal input injection attacks. ⟦This is like entering a high-security laboratory where personal equipment brought from outside cannot be powered on before trust verification, while containment barriers block unauthorized external button signals.⟧ This ensures thorough protection when inspecting unknown code.

items.original: Startup avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before trust is established, and the macOS sandbox blocks terminal input injection. (#42324, #42590)

title.zh-TW: 遠端續接與分支保留已存權限，新工作階段尊重預設模型
title.en: Remote Resume and Fork Preserve Saved Permissions While Fresh Sessions Follow Default Models

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端環境接續或分流既有進度時，設定與權限將維持一致。當你針對遠端工作階段執行續接（resume，接續先前中斷的進度）或分支操作時，先前已經儲存的授權與權限設定現在會完整延續，省去反覆確認授權的打擾。同時，全新開啟的工作階段以及衍生的分支，除非你在指令中明確指定其他模型，否則一律會嚴格遵守伺服器端配置的預設模型規格。⟦正如跨國企業指派主管遠端接管或分流專案小組，原有的門禁通行權限會自動跟隨繼承，而新立案的分支部門也會直接套用總部規範的標準設備，不必每次連線都重新簽呈。⟧此舉確保了跨端協同作業的權限延續性與環境規範。
body.en: Configurations and permissions remain consistent when resuming or branching progress in remote environments. When performing resume or fork operations on remote sessions, previously saved authorizations and permission settings are preserved, eliminating repetitive authorization prompts. Furthermore, fresh sessions and derived forks strictly respect server-configured default models unless you explicitly specify another model in your command. ⟦Just as a multinational enterprise assigns managers to take over or split project teams remotely, existing access permissions are automatically inherited, while newly chartered branch units adopt standard equipment prescribed by headquarters without requiring new approvals for each connection.⟧ This ensures permission continuity and environmental standards during remote collaboration.

items.original: Remote resume and fork operations preserve saved permissions; fresh sessions and forks respect server model defaults unless explicitly overridden. (#43330, #43177, #43355)

title.zh-TW: 跨應用程式續接對話防衝突，提供唯讀逐字紀錄且保留草稿
title.en: Cross-App Conversation Resume Prevents Conflicts with Read-Only Transcripts and Draft Preservation

body.zh-TW: 當你想接續處理某個對話，但該對話正巧在另一個應用程式中開啟時，現在不必再擔心進度衝突了。⟦彷彿走進銀行閱覽保管箱資料，若另一位共同持有者正在櫃檯查閱正本，行員會先為你提供唯讀對照副本與等候重試號碼牌，並妥善看管你正在填寫的申請表格。⟧Codex 會在介面上顯示唯讀的對話轉錄（transcript，完整對話逐字紀錄），讓你能回顧過往脈絡，並附上重新嘗試的按鈕選項。與此同時，你當前輸入框中正在撰寫的文字草稿也會受到完整保護，不會被清空或覆蓋，方便你在另一端釋放鎖定後立刻接手。
body.en: You no longer have to worry about progress conflicts when resuming a conversation that happens to be open in another application. ⟦It is like visiting a bank vault to inspect documents where, if a co-owner is reviewing the original at the counter, the clerk provides a read-only reference copy and a retry ticket while safeguarding the application form you are filling out.⟧ Codex displays a read-only transcript in the interface so you can review past context, accompanied by a retry button option. Meanwhile, your ongoing text draft in the input box remains protected without being cleared or overwritten, allowing you to take over immediately once the lock is released on the other side.

items.original: Resuming a conversation open in another app now shows a read-only transcript with a retry option while preserving your draft. (#43253)

title.zh-TW: 自動核准審查保留壓縮脈絡，遇新指令自動駁回失效授權
title.en: Automatic Approval Reviews Preserve Compaction Context and Reject Invalidated Authorizations

body.zh-TW: 面對需要反覆審核權限的操作流程，自動審查機制的判斷現在更加嚴謹周全。在對話歷程經歷壓縮（compaction，精簡長對話以節省記憶體的機制）後，自動核准審查機制能更完善地保留原本的授權脈絡，避免重要授權因紀錄濃縮而遺失。更重要的是，一旦使用者在後續給出了全新的指令或補充回答，只要先前的核准因此失效，審查機制就會果斷駁回該項核准，防止舊授權被錯誤套用到新情境。⟦類似於建築師審查工程變更單，即使過往會議紀錄經過摘要精簡，簽核依據依然完整留底；而只要業主中途變更了設計需求，先前簽核的舊工單就會立刻作廢重新評估。⟧
body.en: When dealing with workflows that require repeated permission reviews, automatic approval mechanisms are now more rigorous. Following conversation compaction, automatic approval reviews better preserve original authorization context, preventing critical authorizations from being lost due to history condensation. More importantly, once users provide fresh instructions or supplementary answers that invalidate earlier approvals, the review mechanism promptly rejects those approvals to prevent obsolete authorizations from being misapplied in new contexts. ⟦Similar to an architect reviewing engineering change orders, where approval records remain intact even after past meeting notes are summarized, but previously signed work orders are immediately invalidated for re-evaluation whenever the owner alters design requirements midway.⟧

items.original: Automatic approval reviews better preserve authorization context through compaction and reject approvals invalidated by new user instructions or answers. (#42844, #42852, #43442)

entries: Added support for `excludeDefaultComponents: true` in custom agent Markdown frontmatter, allowing custom agents to opt out of default prompt sections and built-in tools while preserving post-invocation hooks.

Improved model API error resilience and diagnostics: transient `genai.APIError` failures (`502`, `503`, `504`, per-minute `429` rate limits, and mid-stream interruptions) automatically retry in-process with exponential backoff while preserving completed tool call outputs, and unrecovered `503` and `429` responses surface clear user-facing error messages.

Improved MCP and provider tool schema validation to preserve open object schemas (such as `{"type": "object"}` or explicit `additionalProperties: true`) instead of rejecting undeclared arguments on schemas that allow them.
Improved per-turn responsiveness and reduced memory usage when opening large conversations.

Fixed `--continue` starting a brand-new conversation when launched from a subdirectory, after a crash, or while another session is open in the same workspace; it now falls back to the most recent non-empty conversation in the current workspace or its parent/child directories.
Fixed full-screen blank flashes in inline mode when content first pushes to scrollback, at the end of a turn, or when clearing the screen with `Ctrl+L`.
Fixed remote companion UIs connected to an interactive CLI session via Remote Control displaying an unauthenticated sign-in screen instead of the active session's signed-in state.
Fixed the status line reporting the terminal sandbox as disabled when the session was launched with the `--sandbox` command-line flag.
Fixed image zoom keys (`Ctrl+=` and `Ctrl+-`) and the footer zoom hint appearing in the artifact viewer when a Mermaid diagram is rendered in ASCII mode instead of as a Kitty image.

title.zh-TW: 自訂代理人支援精簡配置，排除預設提示詞與工具並保留掛鉤
title.en: Custom agents support lean configuration, excluding default prompts and tools while preserving hooks

body.zh-TW:
設計專精特定任務的自訂代理人時，你現在能擁有一張完全乾淨的畫布。在代理人 Markdown 檔案頂端的前言設定（在文件開頭以橫線包夾的設定區塊）加入 `excludeDefaultComponents: true`，便能選擇不載入系統預設的提示詞區段與內建工具，只留下你親自指定的行為邏輯。這項設定能避免通用指令干擾專業發揮。而任務結束後的掛鉤（在特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）依舊完整保留，讓自訂自動化流程順暢運作。⟦宛如訂製專業賽車時選擇拆空內裝的輕量化車體，移除了預設的後座與原廠音響，只留下純粹操控配備，但底盤的安全感應線路依然維持連動。⟧

```yaml
---
name: my-specialist
excludeDefaultComponents: true
---
```
body.en:
When designing custom agents tailored for specialized tasks, you now have a completely blank canvas. Adding `excludeDefaultComponents: true` to the frontmatter of an agent's Markdown file allows you to opt out of loading system default prompt sections and built-in tools, keeping only your explicitly specified behavior logic. This setting prevents general-purpose instructions from interfering with specialized capabilities. Meanwhile, post-task hooks remain fully preserved, keeping custom automated workflows running smoothly. ⟦Just like ordering a purpose-built race car with a stripped lightweight chassis, where default rear seats and factory stereo are removed to keep only pure driving controls, while the safety sensor wiring in the chassis remains connected.⟧

```yaml
---
name: my-specialist
excludeDefaultComponents: true
---
```

items.original: Added support for `excludeDefaultComponents: true` in custom agent Markdown frontmatter, allowing custom agents to opt out of default prompt sections and built-in tools while preserving post-invocation hooks.

title.zh-TW: 模型 API 強化錯誤重試機制，保留工具產出並提供清楚診斷
title.en: Model API strengthens error retry mechanism, preserving tool outputs and providing clear diagnostics

body.zh-TW: 面對遠端模型伺服器偶發的網路壅塞或限流，工具現在具備更沉著的容錯韌性。⟦宛如在自動販賣機投幣購買熱飲遇到出杯口短暫卡頓，機台會主動間隔等待並重新嘗試，妥善保留已落下的紙杯，若最終仍無法出料也會在螢幕亮起明確的缺料警示。⟧以前連線時若撞上暫時性的 `genai.APIError` 錯誤，執行流程往往直接中斷。現在無論是 `502`、`503`、`504` 伺服器異常、每分鐘觸發的 `429` 速率限制，或是傳輸串流中途中斷，程式都會在內部以指數退避（重試等待時間隨次數倍增的做法）自動重試。重試期間已完成的工具呼叫產出會完整保留，不再白白作廢。若重試後仍未能成功復原，系統會針對 `503` 與 `429` 狀況顯示清楚易懂的錯誤提示，不再丟出晦澀難懂的內部代碼。
body.en: When facing occasional network congestion or rate limits from remote model servers, the tool now exhibits calmer fault resilience. ⟦Like buying a hot drink from a vending machine and encountering a brief jam at the dispenser chute: the machine automatically waits at intervals and retries, properly preserving the dropped cup, and illuminates a clear out-of-stock warning on the screen if it ultimately cannot dispense.⟧ Previously, encountering transient `genai.APIError` failures during a connection would often abort execution immediately. Now, whether dealing with `502`, `503`, or `504` server errors, per-minute `429` rate limits, or mid-stream transmission interruptions, the program automatically retries in-process using exponential backoff. Completed tool call outputs during retries are fully preserved rather than wasted. If recovery still fails after retrying, the system displays clear and understandable error messages for `503` and `429` situations instead of throwing obscure internal error codes.

items.original: Improved model API error resilience and diagnostics: transient `genai.APIError` failures (`502`, `503`, `504`, per-minute `429` rate limits, and mid-stream interruptions) automatically retry in-process with exponential backoff while preserving completed tool call outputs, and unrecovered `503` and `429` responses surface clear user-facing error messages.

title.zh-TW: MCP 與工具結構驗證放寬，保留開放物件與自訂參數
title.en: MCP and tool schema validation relaxed, preserving open objects and custom arguments

body.zh-TW: 串接各類外部擴充工具時，規格檢驗不再把合法的彈性輸入擋在門外。使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）或各家模型提供者的擴充工具時，舊版結構驗證機制過於嚴格。即使工具規格本身允許開放物件結構描述（schema，規範資料格式與欄位型別的結構定義），例如宣告為 `{"type": "object"}` 或明確寫出 `additionalProperties: true`，系統過去仍會拒絕傳入任何未預先宣告的引數。現在檢驗邏輯全面改善，能妥善保留這些開放物件結構，讓合規允許額外參數的工具順利接收資料。⟦好比前往公證處填寫資產申報單，欄位末端若明確勾選了「其他動產」或備註允許自由補充，審查櫃台便會如實受理附帶清單，不再挑剔額外寫入的項目未列在制式表格上。⟧
body.en: When integrating external extension tools, specification checks no longer lock out valid, flexible inputs. When using MCP or provider extension tools, the previous schema validation mechanism was overly strict. Even if a tool specification itself allowed open object schemas (such as declaring `{"type": "object"}` or explicitly setting `additionalProperties: true`), the system previously rejected any undeclared arguments. The validation logic is now improved to properly preserve these open object schemas, allowing tools that permit extra parameters to receive data smoothly. ⟦Just like filling out an asset declaration form at a notary office: if the end of a field explicitly checks "other movable property" or notes allow free additions, the review counter accepts the attached list as-is, no longer rejecting extra written items simply because they were not listed on the standard form.⟧

items.original: Improved MCP and provider tool schema validation to preserve open object schemas (such as `{"type": "object"}` or explicit `additionalProperties: true`) instead of rejecting undeclared arguments on schemas that allow them.

title.zh-TW: 開啟大型對話降低記憶體佔用，每輪互動回應更敏捷
title.en: Opening large conversations reduces memory usage, making per-turn responses more agile

body.zh-TW: 重新載入累積大量歷史紀錄的長篇對話時，終端機的操作手感現在依然輕快。⟦這好比翻開一整箱厚重的工程施工藍圖，經過重新折疊與編目整理，攤在桌上不再佔滿整張辦公桌，每次翻到特定樓層做標記也隨翻隨寫、毫無延宕。⟧以前開啟對話紀錄特別長的工作階段（session，從啟動到結束的一整段對話歷程）時，龐大的歷史內容往往會迅速堆高記憶體用量。隨著對話越來越長，每輪互動的送出與回應也常因此變得遲緩。現在開啟大型對話時的每輪回應速度顯著改善，同時有效降低了記憶體消耗。即使面對篇幅極長的工作階段，每次對話往返都能維持順暢反應。
body.en: When reloading lengthy conversations with accumulated history, terminal operations remain snappy. ⟦Like opening a heavy box of engineering construction blueprints that have been refolded and cataloged: spreading them out no longer occupies the entire desk, and flipping to a specific floor to make notes is immediate without any delay.⟧ Previously, opening sessions with extensive conversation histories would rapidly inflate memory usage. As conversations grew longer, sending and receiving responses per turn frequently became sluggish. Now, per-turn responsiveness when opening large conversations is significantly improved while effectively reducing memory consumption. Even in exceptionally long sessions, each conversational turn maintains smooth responsiveness.

items.original: Improved per-turn responsiveness and reduced memory usage when opening large conversations.

title.zh-TW: --continue 支援階層備援搜尋，子目錄與當機後不開新對話
title.en: --continue supports hierarchical fallback search, avoiding new conversations in subdirectories or after crashes

body.zh-TW:
想要迅速接續上一回的中斷進度，恢復對話的指令現在更值得信賴。以前執行 `--continue` 旗標時，只要終端機位於專案的子目錄、先前發生過異常當機，或者同一工作區內恰好有另一個工作階段（session，從啟動到關閉的完整使用過程）正在運行，系統往往會誤判並強制開出一筆全新空白對話。這讓使用者找不到原本的上下文紀錄。現在這項缺陷已經修好，指令會啟動智慧備援（fallback，在主路徑失效時自動切換至替代方案的容錯設計）機制，自動搜尋當前工作區及其父目錄、子目錄，精準找回最近一次非空的歷史對話。⟦恰似工匠走進分流的加工側間準備繼續施工，即使方才經歷了意外跳電、或隔壁主工位正有人借用工具，他依然能在工具架的主層或鄰近抽屜裡，精準摸出最後那份尚未結案的工件繼續雕琢。⟧

```
# 接續當前工作區最近一次非空對話
agy --continue
```
body.en:
When resuming interrupted progress from a previous session, the continuation command is now much more dependable. Previously, running the `--continue` flag would often mistakenly force a brand-new blank conversation if the terminal was located in a project subdirectory, after an abnormal crash, or while another session was running in the same workspace. This left users unable to find their original context history. This flaw has now been fixed; the command initiates a fallback mechanism that automatically searches the current workspace along with its parent and child directories to accurately retrieve the most recent non-empty conversation. ⟦Much like a craftsman stepping into a branch workshop to resume work: even after a sudden power outage or while someone borrows tools at the main workstation next door, he can still reach into the tool rack's main shelf or adjacent drawers to accurately retrieve the last unfinished piece and continue carving.⟧

```
# Resume the most recent non-empty conversation in the current workspace
agy --continue
```

items.original: Fixed `--continue` starting a brand-new conversation when launched from a subdirectory, after a crash, or while another session is open in the same workspace; it now falls back to the most recent non-empty conversation in the current workspace or its parent/child directories.

title.zh-TW: 行內模式修復全螢幕空白閃爍，捲動與清畫面視覺更平順
title.en: Inline mode fixes full-screen blank flashes, smoothing scrolling and screen clearing

body.zh-TW: 長時間在終端機中緊盯對話輸出，刺眼的畫面閃爍不再打擾你的專注。在行內模式（inline mode，直接在終端機當前游標處嵌入文字的顯示方式）下，使用者過去常常會撞見令人不適的全螢幕空白閃爍。這種刺眼的閃動特別容易發生在文字輸出首次被推入回捲緩衝區（scrollback，終端機用來保留上方歷史畫面的暫存區）的那一刻、每一輪對話即將結束的收尾瞬間，或是按下 `Ctrl+L` 快捷鍵嘗試清空螢幕之時。這個畫面閃爍問題現在已經徹底修復，各種切換情境下都能維持穩定的視覺感受。⟦彷彿在老舊放映廳看電影遇到換膠捲捲軸，以前每逢段落切換或清潔布幕時總會突然白光一閃刺傷眼睛，如今更換了數位連續放映機，轉場時畫面銜接安靜平穩。⟧
body.en: When focusing on conversational output in the terminal for long periods, glaring screen flashes no longer disrupt your concentration. In inline mode, users previously often encountered jarring full-screen blank flashes. This glaring flash occurred especially when text output was first pushed into the scrollback buffer, at the closing moment of each conversation turn, or when pressing `Ctrl+L` to clear the screen. This screen flashing issue is now completely fixed, maintaining a stable visual experience across all transition scenarios. ⟦Like watching a movie in an old cinema during a film reel change: paragraph transitions or screen cleanings previously triggered a sudden flash of white light that stung the eyes, but with a new digital continuous projector, transitions now connect quietly and smoothly.⟧

items.original: Fixed full-screen blank flashes in inline mode when content first pushes to scrollback, at the end of a turn, or when clearing the screen with `Ctrl+L`.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 隨附介面狀態修復，即時反映已登入工作階段
title.en: Remote Control companion UI state fixed, instantly reflecting signed-in sessions

body.zh-TW: 使用遠端裝置協同操作終端機時，隨附介面現在能準確同步你已登入的身分。⟦好似持智慧手環與跑步機連線同步運動數據，手環螢幕接通瞬間便會直接顯示當前登入的會員姓名，不再跳回初始歡迎頁逼你重新掃描卡片。⟧以前透過 `Remote Control` 將遠端隨附介面連線至互動式命令列工作階段（session，從啟動到結束的一整段操作歷程）時，介面端常出現異常狀況。它不會顯示當前活動工作階段的有效登入狀態，反而會錯誤彈出未通過驗證的登入畫面，阻礙使用者操作。這個狀態顯示問題現在已經修好，遠端介面連線後能直接反映正常的登入狀態。
body.en: When using remote devices to collaboratively operate the terminal, the companion UI now accurately synchronizes your signed-in identity. ⟦Just like pairing a fitness tracker with a treadmill to sync workout data: the moment the tracker screen connects, it immediately displays the currently logged-in member's name instead of jumping back to the initial welcome page and forcing you to rescan your card.⟧ Previously, connecting a remote companion UI to an interactive CLI session via `Remote Control` often caused an abnormal state on the UI side. Instead of displaying the active session's authenticated sign-in state, it erroneously showed an unauthenticated sign-in screen, hindering operations. This status display issue is now fixed, allowing remote interfaces to directly reflect the normal signed-in state upon connection.

items.original: Fixed remote companion UIs connected to an interactive CLI session via Remote Control displaying an unauthenticated sign-in screen instead of the active session's signed-in state.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列如實反映終端機沙盒狀態，解除旗標設定下的顯示誤判
title.en: Status line accurately reflects terminal sandbox state, resolving false display under flag setting

body.zh-TW:
開啟隔離防護執行不可信指令時，底部狀態提示不再引起虛驚。當你在啟動命令列時加入了 `--sandbox` 命令列旗標，程式明明已經替該工作階段（session，從啟動到關閉的完整執行過程）啟用了終端機沙盒防護。然而畫面底部的狀態列（顯示目前模式與環境資訊的即時通知列）過去卻會錯誤回報沙盒為停用狀態，容易讓人誤以為隔離環境未生效。這個顯示問題現在已經修正，只要使用該旗標啟動，狀態列便會如實反映沙盒的啟用狀態。⟦這如同實驗室操作員戴上護目鏡並扳下通風櫥排氣閥，排風扇明明已正常抽風運轉，警示面板上的指示燈卻誤亮著「排氣已關閉」，校正接線後指示燈終於真實反映抽風狀態。⟧

```
# 以終端機沙盒防護模式啟動工作階段
agy --sandbox
```
body.en:
When enabling isolated protection to execute untrusted commands, bottom status hints no longer cause false alarms. When launching the command line with the `--sandbox` flag, the program properly enables terminal sandbox protection for that session. However, the status line at the bottom of the screen previously erroneously reported the sandbox as disabled, easily leading users to believe the isolated environment was not active. This display issue is now fixed; launching with this flag ensures the status line accurately reflects the sandbox's enabled state. ⟦Much like a lab operator putting on safety goggles and pulling the fume hood exhaust valve: while the exhaust fan is running normally, the indicator light on the warning panel mistakenly shows "Exhaust Off"; after correcting the wiring, the light finally accurately reflects the ventilation status.⟧

```
# Launch session with terminal sandbox protection mode
agy --sandbox
```

items.original: Fixed the status line reporting the terminal sandbox as disabled when the session was launched with the `--sandbox` command-line flag.

title.zh-TW: Mermaid 純文字圖表移除縮放提示，檢視器介面回歸清爽
title.en: Mermaid plain-text diagrams remove zoom hints, restoring clean viewer interface

body.zh-TW: 在終端機檢視流程圖或架構圖時，畫面控制項不再出現用不上的快捷鍵提示。當你在產出物檢視器（artifact viewer，查看程式碼或圖表等生成成果的專用檢視面板）中瀏覽 Mermaid 圖表時，若圖表是以 ASCII 純文字模式而非 Kitty 圖片模式進行算繪，終端機過去依然會顯示圖片專用的縮放按鍵提示。這導致底部的頁尾提示欄列出無效的 `Ctrl+=` 與 `Ctrl+-` 縮放快捷鍵，按下去也沒有實際縮放效果。這個介面提示問題現在已經修正，純文字圖表不再顯示多餘的圖片縮放提示。⟦宛如閱讀以純文字打字機排印的黑白公文，閱讀器底端卻跳出僅適用於高解析度相片的多點觸控手勢指引，移走無效提示後版面回歸乾淨俐落。⟧
body.en: When viewing flowcharts or architecture diagrams in the terminal, UI controls no longer display unusable shortcut hints. When browsing Mermaid diagrams in the artifact viewer, if a diagram was rendered in ASCII plain-text mode rather than Kitty image mode, the terminal previously still showed image zoom key hints. This caused the bottom footer hint bar to list ineffective `Ctrl+=` and `Ctrl+-` zoom shortcuts that had no actual zooming effect when pressed. This UI hint issue is now fixed, so plain-text diagrams no longer display redundant image zoom hints. ⟦Like reading a black-and-white official document printed on a plain typewriter, only for the bottom of the reader to pop up multi-touch gesture guides meant exclusively for high-resolution photos; removing the invalid hints restores a clean, uncluttered layout.⟧

items.original: Fixed image zoom keys (`Ctrl+=` and `Ctrl+-`) and the footer zoom hint appearing in the artifact viewer when a Mermaid diagram is rendered in ASCII mode instead of as a Kitty image.

entries: **The Windows panel opens inside the screen at high display scaling** ([#130](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/130)). pywebview 6.2.1 returns screen bounds in physical pixels but labels them as scale 1.0, while `move()` / `resize()` multiply their input by the window's DPI again. At 250% on 3840x2160 the default x came out as 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448, pinning the panel to the bottom-right edge, and that position was saved, so every relaunch repeated it. Screen rectangles are now converted to logical pixels with the window's own DPI (only when the primary screen reports 1.0 while the window DPI is not 96, so a future pywebview that fixes this is not double-converted), and `window.show()` is queued behind the placement so the panel never appears at a stale position.

**The Windows panel reopens on the display it was closed on with mixed scaling.** The saved position was physical pixels divided by the DPI of whichever monitor the window was on at that moment, so a panel closed on a 225% display reopened on the 100% primary. Positions are now saved in physical pixels and converted with the window's current DPI when placed. The preference key and shape are unchanged.

**The bottom of the Windows panel is no longer cut off on short high-DPI screens.** The 0.6 zoom floor did not account for the window's DPI, so at 2560x1440 @225% the panel was held above the zoom it needed and lost its rate/status row and Refresh/Quit buttons. Windows now uses `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale` as the floor, so text still never renders smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display; macOS is unchanged.

**The Windows tray tooltip is capped at 127 characters.** Since the Grok row was added, the English tooltip with every provider at 100% reached 129 characters; pystray raised `ValueError: string too long`, which `_refresh_worker()` swallowed along with the same iteration's `inject_state()`, so an open panel silently stopped updating.

**Installed status line and session resume hooks are replaced with the current copies.** Both scripts had changed without a version bump — the status line's `1000k` fix and ten session-resume fixes since July — so existing installs kept the old files. The status line goes to `1.6` and session resume to `1.7`, and a new test keeps the session-resume script version and installer constant in step.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板在高縮放螢幕不再貼邊，重開位置精準
title.en: Windows panel no longer clings to screen edge at high scaling, reopening accurately

body.zh-TW: 使用 3840x2160 高解析度螢幕並開啟 250% 縮放時，Windows 面板現在會準確開在畫面之內。⟦這好比木工師傅照著設計圖施工，助手卻誤把圖面上的公尺當成公分再放大換算，讓做好的櫃子直接卡死在牆角。⟧底層套件 `pywebview 6.2.1` 回傳的螢幕範圍明明是實體像素，卻標記成縮放 1.0。後續 `move()` 與 `resize()` 又拿視窗自身 DPI 重複相乘，使得預設水平坐標被算成 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448，將面板釘在右下角邊緣，且該位置還被存檔讓每次重開都重演。現在程式只在主螢幕回報 1.0 且視窗 DPI 不是 96 時，才用視窗自己的 DPI 將螢幕矩形換算回邏輯像素，避免未來 `pywebview` 修好時重複換算；同時將 `window.show()` 排在擺位之後，面板絕不再閃現在舊位置。
body.en: When using a 3840x2160 high-resolution display with 250% scaling, the Windows panel now opens accurately within the screen bounds. ⟦This is like a carpenter building according to blueprints, but an assistant mistakes meters for centimeters and scales them up again, leaving the finished cabinet wedged tightly against the wall corner.⟧ The underlying package `pywebview 6.2.1` returns screen bounds in physical pixels but labels them with a scale of 1.0. Subsequent `move()` and `resize()` operations then multiplied their inputs by the window's own DPI again, causing the default horizontal coordinate to be calculated as 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448, pinning the panel to the bottom-right edge, and that position was saved so every relaunch repeated the issue. Now the program converts screen rectangles back to logical pixels using the window's own DPI only when the primary screen reports 1.0 while the window DPI is not 96, preventing double conversion if a future `pywebview` release fixes this; at the same time, `window.show()` is queued after placement, ensuring the panel never flashes at a stale position.

items.original: **The Windows panel opens inside the screen at high display scaling** ([#130](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/130)). pywebview 6.2.1 returns screen bounds in physical pixels but labels them as scale 1.0, while `move()` / `resize()` multiply their input by the window's DPI again. At 250% on 3840x2160 the default x came out as 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448, pinning the panel to the bottom-right edge, and that position was saved, so every relaunch repeated it. Screen rectangles are now converted to logical pixels with the window's own DPI (only when the primary screen reports 1.0 while the window DPI is not 96, so a future pywebview that fixes this is not double-converted), and `window.show()` is queued behind the placement so the panel never appears at a stale position.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板支援混合縮放多螢幕，重開精準回到原螢幕
title.en: Windows panel supports mixed-scaling multi-monitor setups, reopening precisely on the original display

body.zh-TW: 外接不同螢幕工作的讀者，若各螢幕設定了不同的縮放比例，關閉 Windows 面板後重新開啟，它現在會老實回到當初關閉的那台螢幕。先前系統儲存面板位置時，是把實體像素除以視窗當下所在螢幕的 DPI；這導致在 225% 縮放螢幕上關閉的面板，重新開啟時卻莫名其妙彈回 100% 的主螢幕。新版改為直接儲存實體像素，等到擺放面板位置時，才搭配視窗當下的 DPI 進行換算。⟦這如同在不同比例尺的地圖之間穿梭，標記位置時若除以當前圖紙比例，重新翻開時便會走樣跳回起點；改存真實公尺距離後，在哪張地圖合上就在哪張地圖展開。⟧這項改進完全不改變偏好設定的鍵名與資料格式。
body.en: For users working with external monitors configured with different scale factors, closing the Windows panel and reopening it now reliably returns it to the specific display where it was closed. Previously, the system saved the panel's position by dividing physical pixels by the DPI of whichever display the window was currently on; as a result, a panel closed on a 225% scaling display would unexpectedly jump back to the 100% primary screen upon reopening. The new version saves positions directly in physical pixels and only converts them using the window's current DPI when placing the panel. ⟦This is like navigating between maps of different scales: if marked locations are divided by the current sheet's ratio, reopening them distorts the coordinates back to the starting point; storing the actual meter distances instead ensures that whichever map you close on is where you reopen.⟧ This improvement leaves preference key names and data formats completely unchanged.

items.original: **The Windows panel reopens on the display it was closed on with mixed scaling.** The saved position was physical pixels divided by the DPI of whichever monitor the window was on at that moment, so a panel closed on a 225% display reopened on the 100% primary. Positions are now saved in physical pixels and converted with the window's current DPI when placed. The preference key and shape are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板放寬矮螢幕縮放下限，按鈕與狀態列不再裁切
title.en: Windows panel relaxes zoom floor on short displays, preventing buttons and status row from being cut off

body.zh-TW: 把 Windows 面板開在偏矮的螢幕上時，若曾碰過重新整理或結束按鈕被切出畫面外的窘境，現在這類版面裁切問題已徹底解決。⟦這彷彿在低矮的天花板下擺放展示架，若硬性規定層架間隔不能縮小，最底層的控制旋鈕就會被地面擋住；按空間比例動態調降底線，底部按鍵才不被擠出視野。⟧過去面板設有 0.6 的縮放下限，卻未考慮視窗自身的 DPI，使得 2560x1440 搭配 225% 縮放時，面板被卡在比實際需要更大的縮放比例，導致速率與狀態列以及重新整理和結束按鈕全部掉出畫面之外。現在 Windows 將縮放下限改為 `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale`，確保文字顯示依然絕不小於 100% 螢幕的 0.6 倍，同時讓整張面板順利塞進螢幕內；macOS 則維持原樣不變。
body.en: When opening the Windows panel on shorter screens, any issues where the Refresh or Quit buttons were cut off outside the viewport are now completely resolved. ⟦This is like placing a display rack under a low ceiling: if shelf spacing is rigidly forbidden from shrinking, the bottom control knobs get blocked by the floor; dynamically lowering the floor based on available space keeps bottom buttons from being squeezed out of view.⟧ Previously, the panel enforced a 0.6 zoom floor without accounting for the window's own DPI, causing the panel at 2560x1440 with 225% scaling to remain stuck above the zoom level it actually needed, which pushed the rate and status row as well as the Refresh and Quit buttons entirely off-screen. Windows now changes the zoom floor to `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale`, ensuring text rendering is still never smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display while allowing the entire panel to fit smoothly inside the screen; macOS remains unchanged.

items.original: **The bottom of the Windows panel is no longer cut off on short high-DPI screens.** The 0.6 zoom floor did not account for the window's DPI, so at 2560x1440 @225% the panel was held above the zoom it needed and lost its rate/status row and Refresh/Quit buttons. Windows now uses `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale` as the floor, so text still never renders smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display; macOS is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣提示限制字數，避免例外吞沒導致面板停更
title.en: Windows tray tooltip enforces character limit, preventing swallowed exceptions from stalling panel updates

body.zh-TW: 開啟 Windows 系統匣觀察各家 AI 用量，開著的面板現在絕不會無聲無息地停止更新。先前新增了 Grok 欄位之後，在英文介面且每家提供商額度皆滿 100% 的極端狀況下，提示文字長度會達到 129 個字元；這讓底層圖示套件 `pystray` 拋出 `ValueError: string too long` 錯誤，但該錯誤卻被背景工作常駐程式 `_refresh_worker()` 默默吞掉，連同該輪更新畫面的 `inject_state()` 也一併跳過，導致面板看似開著卻再也不會刷新數據。現在系統匣提示文字強制限制在 127 個字元以內，徹底防範字串過長引發的崩潰。⟦這種脫節宛如展場跑馬燈因文字過長當機，值班警衛不但沒回報還順手切斷訊號線，讓大廳螢幕默默停在上一輪舊畫面。⟧
body.en: When opening the Windows tray to check AI usage across providers, an open panel will no longer silently stop updating. Previously, after adding the Grok row, tooltip text reached 129 characters in the extreme case of an English interface with every provider's quota at 100%; this caused the underlying icon library `pystray` to raise a `ValueError: string too long` error, which was silently swallowed by the background worker `_refresh_worker()`, skipping that cycle's UI update `inject_state()` as well and leaving the open panel unable to refresh data. The tray tooltip text is now strictly capped at 127 characters, completely preventing crashes caused by excessively long strings. ⟦This disconnection is like an exhibition marquee crashing from text that is too long, and instead of reporting it, the duty guard casually disconnects the signal cable, leaving the lobby display quietly frozen on the previous frame.⟧

items.original: **The Windows tray tooltip is capped at 127 characters.** Since the Grok row was added, the English tooltip with every provider at 100% reached 129 characters; pystray raised `ValueError: string too long`, which `_refresh_worker()` swallowed along with the same iteration's `inject_state()`, so an open panel silently stopped updating.

title.zh-TW: 終端機狀態列與接續提醒自動換新，補齊修復並校準版號
title.en: Terminal status line and session resume hooks update automatically, incorporating fixes and aligning version numbers

body.zh-TW: 先前已在電腦中安裝過狀態列與工作階段接續提醒的使用者，現在升級時會自動替換成最新版腳本。過去這兩支 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）雖然歷經多次修改，涵蓋狀態列進位的 `1000k` 修正以及 7 月以來工作階段接續提醒的十項修正，卻因為未調升版號，讓既有安裝一直留在舊檔案。新版將狀態列升級至 1.6 版、接續提醒升級至 1.7 版，安裝程式會主動用最新副本覆蓋舊檔，並新增自動化測試確保腳本版號與安裝常數隨時步調一致。⟦這恰似圖書館借閱處更新了服務規章，封皮上的版本代號卻漏未換新，讓館員誤以為抽屜裡積滿灰塵的舊手冊仍是現行規定。⟧
body.en: Users who previously installed the status line and session resume hooks on their systems will now have them automatically replaced with the latest script versions upon upgrading. In the past, although both hooks underwent numerous modifications—including the status line rounding fix for `1000k` and ten fixes to session resume since July—the lack of version bumps left existing installations stuck on older files. ## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.

body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧
